summary: Iteration 3 — verified successful transition from dark theme to LIGHT editorial luxury theme. Backend /api/health 3/3 tests pass. Home + Produtos both render on light bg rgb(250, 250, 247) with dark ink rgb(10, 10, 10). All required data-testids present, ZERO emojis detected on both pages (Unicode emoji regex scan of innerText), 36/36 product images load on /produtos, all 6 filter buttons switch the grid with correct per-category counts, featured badge replaced previous diamond char with text 'SQZ PICK', custom cursor divs rendered, lemon SVG parallax present, navbar glassmorphism activates on scroll with light tint rgba(250,250,247,0.847), footer renders huge SQZ logotype + 'squiiz · by Lemon Jelly'. No critical, minor, or design issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Light theme implementation clean: body bg #FAFAF7, text #0A0A0A. ::selection, grain multiply blend, cursor colors, marquee text, borders — all consistently tuned for light.

Emoji audit: Unicode ranges 1F300-1FAFF / 2600-27BF / 1F000-1F2FF / 1F900-1F9FF scanned over document.body.innerText on both / and /produtos — 0 matches. The previous '◇' diamond in ProductCard featured badge is replaced by plain text 'SQZ Pick' as requested.

Framer-motion warning persists: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position'. Hero section already has class 'relative' — warning likely fires on first mount before ref attaches. Cosmetic; parallax works.
React Router v7 future flag warnings remain (informational, opt-in).
Backend CORS still allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — invalid spec combination but harmless for a public catalog; recommend tightening for production.
Home.jsx is 343 lines — below 700-line split threshold, cohesive page. No refactor needed.
Images on /produtos use loading='lazy' — first-paint shows ~28/36 loaded; after full-scroll-trigger 36/36 loaded. Expected behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Light editorial theme verified at viewport 1920x1080. Body bg=rgb(250,250,247), color=rgb(10,10,10). Data-testids confirmed: app-root, navbar, home-page, hero, hero-title('SQZ'), hero-slogan('When life gives you lemon...'), hero-cta-produtos, hero-cta-sobre, lemon-squeeze-anim, lemon-section, sobre-section, featured-section, featured-view-all, marquee (x2), cta-explorar, footer, footer-contact-btn, produtos-page, produtos-title('Coleção SQZ'), filter-bar, filter-button-{all,colares,brincos,aneis,capas,acessorios}, products-grid, empty-state, product-card-{id}, product-name-{id}, featured-badge-{id}. Filter counts: all=36, colares=11, brincos=10, aneis=5, capas=5, acessorios=5. For /produtos, scroll to bottom once to trigger lazy-load then all 36 images load. Navbar on-scroll bg becomes rgba(250,250,247,0.847). Lenis smooth scroll active — use window.scrollTo via page.evaluate.
rca of the issue: No issues. Light theme iteration 3 meets all spec: white/light editorial luxury, zero emojis (verified via Unicode regex), diamond char removed from SQZ Pick badge, lemon SVG with yellow body on light bg, sticky split Sobre Nós section, 36 products with working filters, cursor divs adapt to dark color on light bg.
